title: Enable Resizable BAR
name: resizable-bar
modal: WARNING: Your PC will restart IMMEDIATELY into the BIOS/UEFI setup. Save all work first. Enable Above 4G Decoding first, then Re-Size BAR Support. Do not change anything else.
description: Checks GPU and boot mode, then reboots to BIOS to enable Resizable BAR for more GPU frames
deepDescription:
Resizable BAR lets the CPU access the full GPU memory at once, adding FPS in supported games. Requires a dedicated NVIDIA, AMD or Intel Arc GPU and UEFI boot. This tweak verifies that, then reboots you into BIOS. Enable there:

- Above 4G Decoding → On (required first)
- Re-Size BAR Support → On
warning: PC restarts immediately. Save your work first.
